nodes.label: jallure
nodes.rationale: Groovy-based integration that generates Allure Report compatible results directly during Apache JMeter test execution. Not suitable for load testing — designed for functional/API test reporting.

nodes.label: JSR223 Assertion
nodes.rationale: jallure.groovy is attached as a JSR223 Assertion to JMeter samplers because it reads prev (PreviousResult) after the sampler executes.

nodes.label: Orphaned Label Leak
nodes.rationale: When a multi-step test case does not receive a stop, allure.label.* variables remain in JMeter's vars and may leak into the next test case. The reporter cannot fix this automatically because jallure.groovy runs as a JSR223 Assertion after the HTTP sampler, while annotations are declared in a JSR223 Sampler before the HTTP sampler. By the time the reporter sees a new start, vars already contains a mix of old leaked labels and new intentional ones.

nodes.label: clearLabels Pattern
nodes.rationale: Recommended workaround for the Orphaned Label Leak: add a one-time init sampler at the start of the ThreadGroup that stores a clearLabels closure, then call it inside any declaration sampler that must start with a clean label state.

nodes.label: jallure.groovy
nodes.rationale: Assembled self-contained Groovy script produced by ./gradlew assembleJallureScripts from the modular classes under src/main/groovy/io/github/forcasic/jmeter/allure/.

nodes.label: JSR223 Sampler
nodes.rationale: Used to declare Allure annotations before the HTTP sampler runs because annotations must be in vars before jallure.groovy is invoked.

nodes.label: _ALLURE_REPORT_PATH
nodes.rationale: JMeter variable that sets the output directory for allure-results. Defaults to allureReport/allureResults relative to JMeter's baseDir if unset.

nodes.label: _ALLURE_CONFIG_PATH
nodes.rationale: JMeter variable that points to the assembled jallure.groovy script file used by the JSR223 Assertion filename field.

nodes.label: start parameter
nodes.rationale: First step of a multi-step test. Performs cleanup, generates a new UUID, and begins accumulating steps.

nodes.label: continue parameter
nodes.rationale: Intermediate step of a multi-step test; appends a step to the current case.

nodes.label: stop parameter
nodes.rationale: Last step of a multi-step test; finalizes the case, writes the JSON result, updates counters, and calls clearAllureVariable().

nodes.label: solo parameter
nodes.rationale: Invoked when the JSR223 Assertion Parameters field is empty; performs a full start-to-stop cycle in a single call.

nodes.label: clearAllureVariable
nodes.rationale: Cleanup routine triggered always when start is present and on stop or solo. Resets prevMainSteps, SummarySubSteps, AResult, allureCaseFailReason, allureCaseResult, critical, loopCounter, _allureLastStepStart, allure.name, allure.description, all allure.label.*, and allure.links.

nodes.label: _allureCaseUUID
nodes.rationale: UUID of the test case itself. Generated on start or solo and reused on continue/stop.

nodes.label: attachment UUID
nodes.rationale: Generated anew for each step and used to name request/response attachment files.

nodes.label: no_report modifier
nodes.rationale: Modifier that prevents writing result.json and attachments, useful for debugging.

nodes.label: tika_xml modifier
nodes.rationale: Modifier that uses Apache Tika for parsing binary responses such as xlsx.

nodes.label: critical modifier
nodes.rationale: Modifier that stops the thread if the step fails by calling prev.setStopThread(true).

nodes.label: parameters modifier
nodes.rationale: Modifier that adds step-level parameters to the current step, e.g. parameters=[var1,var2].

nodes.label: allure.name variable
nodes.rationale: JMeter variable that sets the test case name in the report.

nodes.label: allure.label.feature variable
nodes.rationale: JMeter variable that sets the Allure feature label.

nodes.label: allure.label.story variable
nodes.rationale: JMeter variable that sets the Allure story label.

nodes.label: allure.label.epic variable
nodes.rationale: JMeter variable that sets the Allure epic label.

nodes.label: allure.parameters variable
nodes.rationale: JMeter variable that lists comma-separated JMeter variable names to include as test case parameters.

nodes.label: allure.links variable
nodes.rationale: JMeter variable that sets links in type,url,type,url format.

nodes.label: Allure result file format
nodes.rationale: Each test case is written as one JSON file <uuid>-result.json in allureResults/ containing name, description, status, stage, start, stop, uuid, historyId, fullName, steps, labels, parameters, and links.

nodes.label: Solo test pattern
nodes.rationale: One HTTP request equals one test case; the JSR223 Assertion Parameters field is left empty. Used for simple API checks, smoke tests, and requests inside a loop.

nodes.label: Multi-step test pattern
nodes.rationale: A chain of HTTP requests forms one test case using start, continue, and stop parameters. Used for business scenarios consisting of several steps.

nodes.label: Start+Stop single step pattern
nodes.rationale: Parameters set to start,stop on a single request. Equivalent to a multi-step test with one step; used to explicitly mark case boundaries when there is only one step.
